nodes.label: Evolution API Logo
nodes.description: SVG logo for 'Evolution API' (479x106px). Brand name spelled out in stylized text: 'evolution' in light grey (#D8D8D8) and 'api' in bright green (#00FFA7). Features a geometric icon at left composed of green (#00FFA7) rectangular/square shapes suggesting connectivity or network topology. Also includes a connected-nodes/chain motif in the upper-right area in green, suggesting API connectivity or webhook chaining. This is the WhatsApp messaging gateway used by BelPro for volunteer communication.
